text: The purpose of this report is to provide the Board with information in regards to the resolution of certain Sony Centre Redevelopment Issues.

The Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto: 1. Received the report (March 21, 2018) from the Vice President of Finance and Administration and the City Solicitor for information. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 21, 2018) from the Vice President of Finance and Administration and the City Solicitor remain confidential as it pertains to the receiving of advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege and the security of the property of the municipality or local board.
